verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of Postgres full-text search (tsvector/GIN indexes, textSearch client API, or Supabase's documented full-text search guide), even though this is a plausible and common Postgres-backed feature for a database platform like Supabase. Only vector/embedding search (pgvector) and generic REST/Realtime APIs are cited, none of which constitute evidence for full-text search support.
